risks.risk: The TV may be non-functional or have display defects (e.g., dead pixels, backlight issues, or screen burn-in)
risks.proof: A video showing the TV turning on, displaying various test patterns (black, white, grayscale, color bars), and demonstrating full motion and brightness range.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-working or with display defects

risks.risk: The TV may be a refurbished or used unit with hidden damage (e.g., cracked screen, damaged ports, or internal wear)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the screen edges, bezel, ports, and back panel, including any signs of scratches, dents, or wear.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with potential hidden damage

risks.risk: The model may not be genuine or may be a counterfeit or rebranded unit
risks.proof: Photo of the physical model label on the back of the TV, or a serial number scan via Samsung's official verification tool.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially counterfeit or non-genuine

proof_requests: Video of the TV turning on and displaying test patterns (black, white, grayscale, color bars) to verify functionality and screen quality.
Close-up photos of the back panel showing the model label and serial number.
Photos of all ports and connections on the back of the TV.
Photo of the TV's remote control and any included accessories.
response.reason: While the model and brand are clearly visible on the screen, critical risks such as functionality, physical condition, and authenticity cannot be confirmed from the current photos. The TV must be verified with additional proof before pricing.
